operational_definition: SLM+typed wrong and row-label accuracy below 0.90
interpretation: Local semantic-label noise still matters; cheap workers are not solved readers.

operational_definition: SLM+typed wrong despite row-label accuracy at least 0.90
interpretation: Small local errors or schema edge cases can flip exact aggregate answers.

operational_definition: Standard RLM wrong because the run produced timeout/scaffold error text
interpretation: The deployed RLM stack has length-sensitive reliability failures not seen in direct Gemini.

operational_definition: Direct Gemini wrong without infrastructure error
interpretation: Removing RLM recursion does not solve the aggregation task; direct reading remains noisy.

operational_definition: Standard RLM wrong without captured timeout/scaffold error
interpretation: Most RLM failures are ordinary wrong answers, with scaffold errors adding a reliability tail.
